title: Unit 2 Progress Quiz: What Lives Here?

questions.question: Choose the correct word: 'Trees that lose their leaves every autumn are called ___ trees.' (coniferous / deciduous / evergreen)
questions.canDoStatement: I can identify and define specific forest biome terminology.

questions.question: Choose the correct word: 'Bears sleep through the cold winter to save energy; this means they ___.' (adapt / hibernate / survive)
questions.canDoStatement: I can explain animal behavioral adaptations using target science vocabulary.

questions.question: Choose the correct word: 'Thick white fur helps animals ___ in the snowy coniferous forest.' (survive / weave / paid)
questions.canDoStatement: I can use verbs related to ecological survival in context.

questions.question: Choose the correct word: 'Wen Shu used a wooden ___ to shoot a stone at the swallows' nest.' (slingshot / roof / chrysalis)
questions.canDoStatement: I can recall specific objects and actions from a literary text.

questions.question: How do coniferous trees adapt to freezing winter temperatures as low as -50°C?
questions.answer: They have thin, dark green needles and cones instead of broad leaves or flowers, allowing them to remain evergreen without drying out.
questions.canDoStatement: I can explain physical plant adaptations in informational science texts.

questions.question: In 'A New Friend', why did the mother swallow give Go Ne a magical gold seed?
questions.answer: She gave it to him as a reward of gratitude because Go Ne and his father saved her baby bird when it fell from the nest.
questions.canDoStatement: I can identify character motivations and cause-and-effect relationships in a folk tale.

questions.question: What was the author's purpose for writing 'Two Different Forests' compared to 'A New Friend'?
questions.answer: 'Two Different Forests' was written to teach/inform readers about forest biomes, while 'A New Friend' was written to entertain and teach a moral lesson about kindness.
questions.canDoStatement: I can analyze and contrast author's purpose (to inform vs. to entertain) across different genres.

questions.question: Which word is spelled with the vowel team 'ai'? (stay / rain / plane / lake)
questions.canDoStatement: I can identify the 'ai' spelling pattern for the long-a sound.

questions.question: Fill in the missing 'ai' spelling pattern to complete these two words from the reading: 1. p___d (gave money) 2. s___led (traveled through the air)
questions.canDoStatement: I can accurately spell words containing the 'ai' vowel digraph.

questions.question: Combine the ideas using 'so they can': 'Some animals change color in winter. They hide in the snow.'
questions.answer: Some animals change color in winter so they can hide in the snow.
questions.canDoStatement: I can form complex sentences expressing purpose and adaptation using 'so (that) + subject + can'.

questions.question: Fill in the blank using 'instead of': 'Coniferous trees have cones ___ flowers or fruit.'
questions.canDoStatement: I can use the prepositional phrase 'instead of' to express ecological contrast.

questions.question: Write 2 or 3 sentences about how an animal adapts to survive in its habitat (OR describe a time when kindness helped solve a problem).
questions.answer: Accept any coherent 2-3 sentence response using target concepts (e.g., 'The snowshoe hare lives in a cold coniferous forest. It grows thick white fur so it can hide from wolves in the winter snow. This helps it survive.'). Criteria: 2 marks content/accuracy, 1 mark grammar/sentence structure, 1 mark spelling/punctuation.
questions.canDoStatement: I can compose short scientific or moral explanation paragraphs applying unit vocabulary and grammar.
